findings.summary: The new `__next__` override raises EOFError instead of StopIteration, so commands iterating over sys.stdin, the stdin text stream, or a click.File('-') argument crash when input runs out instead of ending the loop; EOFError should be raised only in visible_input/hidden_input.

The pipeline test dropped the `not result.exception` assertion and slices off the last two output lines with `[:-2]`, so it now accepts a run that ends in an abort and would pass on real failures that add output lines.
